name: Tōnoshō (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Tōnoshō town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing the character 庄.
history: Municipal flag of Tōnoshō, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 1965.

features.role: Tōnoshō town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing the character 庄
